notIdeasOfWhatSocietyShouldBe.explanation: Wikipedia opens: "The Right Opposition ... in the All-Union Communist Party (Bolsheviks) was a label formulated by Joseph Stalin in Autumn of 1928 for the opposition ... led by Nikolai Bukharin, Alexei Rykov, Mikhail Tomsky, and their supporters", and its infobox calls it a 1928-1930 faction of the Soviet Communist Party. It is a faction (a group of people, with a leadership and a membership), not a set of ideas; its ideas (Bukharinism, pro-NEP socialism in one country) are audited separately.
